question: 不同年龄段用户的客单价分布情况
gold_sql:
select case
  when u.age between 18 and 25 then '18-25岁'
  when u.age between 26 and 35 then '26-35岁'
  when u.age between 36 and 45 then '36-45岁'
  when u.age between 46 and 60 then '46-60岁'
  else '60岁以上'
end as age_bucket,
  sum(o.total_amount) / count(distinct o.order_id) as avg_order_value
from orders o left join users u on o.user_id = u.user_id
where o.status = '已完成'
group by age_bucket
order by age_bucket
raw_output:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN u.age BETWEEN 18 AND 25 THEN '18-25岁'
        WHEN u.age BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN '26-35岁'
        WHEN u.age BETWEEN 36 AND 45 THEN '36-45岁'
        WHEN u.age BETWEEN 46 AND 60 THEN '46-60岁'
        WHEN u.age >= 61 THEN '60岁以上'
        ELSE '其他'
    END AS age_group,
    AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id
WHERE o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY age_group
